entities.summary: Benjamin Anthony DiNucci is an American professional football quarterback. He played college football for the Pittsburgh Panthers and James Madison Dukes and was selected by the Dallas Cowboys of the NFL in the seventh round of the 2020 NFL draft. He has also played for the Seattle Sea Dragons in the XFL in 2023, leading them to the playoffs.
